sources_purpose: Where Lodestar finds torrents: the DHT and the other sources. Each source can be turned on or off and given a share of the fetch work. Turning one off stops it at once; turning one on takes effect at the next start.
sources_load_failed: Couldn't load the sources. Nothing was changed.
sources_stale: Couldn't refresh. What you see may be out of date.
sources_empty_text: This build has no source plugins.
sources_setup_consent: Needs setup before it can be turned on: you must first read and accept what it does.
sources_setup_endpoints: Needs setup before it can be turned on: you must first accept the sites it contacts.
sources_setup_credentials: Needs setup before it can be turned on: it needs your account details first. Setup is not available on this screen yet.
sources_setup_password: Needs your password to be turned on.
sources_error_network: Couldn't reach Lodestar. Nothing was changed.
sources_error_needs_setup: This source needs setup before it can be turned on. Nothing was changed.
sources_error_purge_running: A purge is running for this source. Nothing was changed.
sources_error_code: The change was refused ({code}). Nothing was changed.
sources_cx_external_p1: When it's on, Lodestar contacts these sites on your behalf: {hosts}. They can see your IP address (or your VPN's) and when you connect, as they would if you visited them. Lodestar sends them search terms and info hashes, never your files or your account details.
sources_cx_external_p2: Traffic goes through this source's network setting ({egress}). If the list of sites changes in an update, you'll be asked again.
sources_cx_account_p1: Enter the credentials {name} needs. Lodestar encrypts them on this server and uses them only to talk to {hosts}. They're never shown again, written to logs, included in a settings export or sent anywhere else. You can remove them at any time, and purging the source deletes them.
sources_cx_account_p2: Results found only through your account stay on this server: Lodestar never shares them through Torznab, Stremio, exports or public peer finding, because private trackers usually forbid it. If a public source reports the same torrent, it's treated as public.
sources_cx_restricted_title: {name} can expose you to legal risk.
sources_cx_restricted_p1: {name} reaches sources that may index copyrighted or otherwise restricted material, or it announces your IP address to other peers. Depending on where you live, using it can break the law or your internet provider's terms, and other people can see that your address took part.
sources_cx_restricted_b1: Lodestar collects metadata only: names, sizes and hashes. It doesn't download content.
sources_cx_restricted_b2: **Use a VPN.** Set this source's network setting to your VPN, so the kill switch stops it if the VPN drops.
sources_cx_restricted_b3: You're responsible for whether using it is lawful where you are.
sources_cx_restricted_p2: Enter your password to turn it on. You'll be asked again if this notice changes.
sources_cx_overlay_p1: {name} connects Lodestar to {network}, a separate peer-to-peer network. Other peers on it can see your IP address (or your VPN's), and what you search for may be visible to them. That network has its own content and its own risks, and Lodestar can't check what others share there.
sources_cx_overlay_b1: **Use a VPN** for this source, so the kill switch stops it if the VPN drops.
sources_cx_overlay_b2: What it finds is kept apart from your BitTorrent results, and **Purge** removes all of it in one step.
sources_cx_overlay_b3: Lodestar collects metadata only. It doesn't download content.
sources_cx_overlay_p2: Enter your password to turn it on. You'll be asked again if this notice changes.
sources_cx_password_help: Asked every time. It isn't stored.
sources_cx_wrong_password: That password is wrong. Nothing was changed. Check it and try again.
sources_cx_stale: What this notice covers changed. Close this window and open it again to read it.
sources_purge_body: Purging turns {name} off and permanently deletes:
sources_purge_item_claims: the torrents only {name} found, and its claims on torrents others found too
sources_purge_undo: This can't be undone. Torrents that other sources found too are kept.
sources_purge_cancelled: The purge was cancelled. What it deleted stays deleted, and {name} stays off. Purge again to finish.
sources_purge_failed: The purge stopped before it finished. What it deleted stays deleted, and {name} stays off. Purge again to finish.
sources_purge_wait: The purge is still running. You can close this window; it keeps going.
sources_purge_busy: A purge is already running for this source. Nothing was changed.
sources_purge_result_kept: Kept because other sources found them too: {count}
sources_purge_lost: Couldn't check on the purge. It may still be running. Close this window and look at this source's status here in a minute; if it says "Purge unfinished", purge it again.
